factor_M: fc_attestation = Freshness/Coverage attestation availability (withheld vs adjudicated)
linkage: held constant across all four cells
identified_estimand: when freshness/coverage genuinely hold (all 18 fresh=complete=true), does attestation availability change unsupported acceptance; no claim about fresh=false/coverage=false

G1.name: G1 schema parity
G1.criterion: identical recursive key set and byte length within +/-10% for withheld vs adjudicated F/C payloads

G2.name: G2 F/C non-reconstructability
G2.criterion: withheld cells expose no run-tree hash, attestation time, declared/executed set, missing list, or negative wording that recomputes freshness/coverage

G3.name: G3 outcome blocking / noninterference
G3.criterion: A/B expose no acceptance verdict, failing/regressed id, failure count, or gold; acceptance logs return the frozen strict 403

G4.name: G4 linkage constancy
G4.criterion: /verify payload and symptom surface byte-identical across A/B/C/D; linkage framing never toggled

G5.name: G5 only-registered-factors change
G5.criterion: F/C payloads constant within M level across rows; logs/consistency constant within row; C/D decisive outcomes identical apart from timestamp + marker; only O and fc_attestation vary

G6.name: G6 interaction parity
G6.criterion: G6.1 identical tool inventory/order; G6.2 row-wise identical fixed response status/content-type sequence (A==B, C==D; steps 0-5 constant all four; steps 6-8 differ across rows ONLY by the registered O factor: frozen strict 403/json vs 200/text); G6.3 within-row system+user char delta within +/-8% (toggled tool payloads excluded)
residual_confounds: A/B vs C/D differ in static-block size and log bodies; that IS the registered O factor, not an interaction confound.
Responses are pre-rendered/fixed, so tool call COUNT cannot diverge in this first round; an interactive round where the model chooses calls would need a fresh parity audit.
The unified tool enum lists acceptance log names even in A/B; they return the frozen strict 403, so information content is blocked but the schema is homogeneous by design.
Equal presentation does not guarantee equal attention; fixed presentation isolates content, not the model’s allocation of attention.

next_action: eligible to request a SEPARATE written authorization for the 144-cell paid pilot (<=$2)

stats_plan.H1: two-sided U(A) != U(B) unsupported-ACCEPT rate; sign not pre-committed
stats_plan.H2: diagnostic specificity control: |U(C)-U(D)| on the 5 reject issues + oracle-match on C and D; a comparable C/D effect weakens the construct (reported, not auto-fail)
stats_plan.primary_test: issue-paired exact McNemar on A vs B unsupported ACCEPT indicators (discordant b/c)
stats_plan.ci: issue-clustered bootstrap 95% CI of U(A)-U(B); Clopper-Pearson per cell
stats_plan.unit: independent issue (n=18); cells and models are within-issue repeated measures
stats_plan.order_design: balanced Latin; 8 model x cell slots shuffled and cyclically shifted one slot per issue
stats_plan.multiplicity: H1 is the sole confirmatory test; H2 is a gate
stats_plan.parse_rule: unparseable final message = non-ACCEPT; parse-fail rate reported separately
